motds.body: Discover the epic PvE action-building co-operative campaign that started it all, now free-to-play! Fight back against monster hordes with your friends and explore a vast, destructible world where every map offers unique challenges. Build massive forts, craft powerful weapons, find loot, and level up your Heroes in this expansive adventure.
